schema_setup: CREATE TABLE cte_scope_target(n INTEGER); INSERT INTO cte_scope_target VALUES (10),(11); CREATE VIEW cte_scope_view AS SELECT * FROM cte_scope_target; CREATE VIEW cte_scope_alias AS SELECT n AS alias_n FROM cte_scope_target; CREATE VIEW cte_scope_layer AS SELECT alias_n AS layered_n FROM cte_scope_alias; CREATE VIEW cte_scope_computed AS SELECT n, 1/0 AS bad FROM cte_scope_target; CREATE VIEW cte_scope_subquery AS SELECT n, (SELECT n + 1) AS calc FROM cte_scope_target; CREATE VIEW cte_scope_returning AS SELECT n, (SELECT incoming.v FROM (VALUES (7)) incoming(v)) AS calc FROM cte_scope_target; CREATE FUNCTION public.generate_series(integer, integer) RETURNS SETOF integer LANGUAGE sql AS 'SELECT $1 + 100'

cases.name: local_update
cases.query: WITH c AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM pg_temp.host_rows(100)) UPDATE cte_scope_view SET n = (SELECT 1/n FROM c LIMIT 1) RETURNING n

cases.name: local_delete
cases.query: WITH c AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM pg_temp.host_rows(100)) DELETE FROM cte_scope_view WHERE n > (SELECT 1/n FROM c LIMIT 1) RETURNING n

cases.name: outer_alias
cases.query: WITH c AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM pg_temp.host_rows(100)) UPDATE cte_scope_alias SET alias_n = (SELECT alias_n FROM c LIMIT 1) RETURNING alias_n

cases.name: direct_local_update
cases.query: UPDATE cte_scope_view SET n = (SELECT 1/n FROM pg_temp.host_rows(100) LIMIT 1) RETURNING n

cases.name: direct_local_delete
cases.query: DELETE FROM cte_scope_view WHERE n > (SELECT 1/n FROM pg_temp.host_rows(100) LIMIT 1) RETURNING n

cases.name: direct_outer_alias
cases.query: UPDATE cte_scope_alias SET alias_n = (SELECT alias_n FROM pg_temp.host_rows(100) LIMIT 1) RETURNING alias_n

cases.name: nested_local
cases.query: UPDATE cte_scope_view SET n = (SELECT (SELECT 1/n) FROM pg_temp.host_rows(100) LIMIT 1) RETURNING n

cases.name: nested_outer_alias
cases.query: UPDATE cte_scope_alias SET alias_n = (SELECT (SELECT alias_n FROM pg_temp.host_rows(2) LIMIT 1) FROM pg_temp.host_rows(2) LIMIT 1) RETURNING alias_n

cases.name: inner_local_shadows_ancestor
cases.query: UPDATE cte_scope_view SET n = (SELECT (SELECT 1/n FROM pg_temp.host_rows(100) LIMIT 1) FROM (VALUES (9)) v(n)) RETURNING n

cases.name: derived_local
cases.query: UPDATE cte_scope_view SET n = (SELECT 1/n FROM (SELECT * FROM pg_temp.host_rows(100)) r LIMIT 1) RETURNING n

cases.name: qualified_local
cases.query: UPDATE cte_scope_view SET n = (SELECT 1/cte_scope_view.n FROM pg_temp.host_rows(100) AS cte_scope_view LIMIT 1) RETURNING n

cases.name: qualified_outer_alias
cases.query: UPDATE cte_scope_alias SET alias_n = (SELECT cte_scope_alias.alias_n FROM pg_temp.host_rows(100) LIMIT 1) RETURNING alias_n

cases.name: layered_outer_alias
cases.query: UPDATE cte_scope_layer SET layered_n = (SELECT layered_n FROM pg_temp.host_rows(100) LIMIT 1) RETURNING layered_n

cases.name: ambiguous_local
cases.query: UPDATE cte_scope_view SET n = (SELECT n FROM pg_temp.host_rows(2) a CROSS JOIN pg_temp.host_rows(2) b LIMIT 1) RETURNING n

cases.name: local_predicate
cases.query: UPDATE cte_scope_view SET n = (SELECT n FROM pg_temp.host_rows(100) WHERE n = 0 LIMIT 1) RETURNING n

cases.name: outer_alias_predicate
cases.query: UPDATE cte_scope_alias SET alias_n = (SELECT n FROM pg_temp.host_rows(100) WHERE alias_n = 10 AND n = 2 LIMIT 1) RETURNING alias_n

cases.name: computed_fallback
cases.query: UPDATE cte_scope_computed SET n = (SELECT bad FROM pg_temp.host_rows(100) LIMIT 1) RETURNING n

cases.name: computed_shadowed
cases.query: UPDATE cte_scope_computed SET n = (SELECT bad FROM pg_temp.host_bad_rows(100) LIMIT 1) RETURNING n

cases.name: nested_computed_shadowed
cases.query: UPDATE cte_scope_computed SET n = (SELECT (SELECT bad) FROM pg_temp.host_bad_rows(100) LIMIT 1) RETURNING n

cases.name: set_local
cases.query: UPDATE cte_scope_view SET n = (SELECT 1/n FROM pg_temp.host_rows(100) UNION ALL SELECT 9 LIMIT 1) RETURNING n

cases.name: distinct_outer_alias
cases.query: UPDATE cte_scope_alias SET alias_n = (SELECT DISTINCT alias_n FROM pg_temp.host_rows(2) LIMIT 1) RETURNING alias_n

cases.name: subquery_fallback
cases.query: UPDATE cte_scope_subquery SET n = (SELECT calc FROM pg_temp.host_rows(100) LIMIT 1) RETURNING n

cases.name: qualifier_collision
cases.query: UPDATE cte_scope_alias SET alias_n = (SELECT alias_n FROM pg_temp.host_rows(100) AS cte_scope_alias LIMIT 1) RETURNING alias_n

cases.name: source_outer_argument
cases.query: UPDATE cte_scope_alias SET alias_n = (SELECT n FROM pg_temp.host_rows(alias_n) LIMIT 1) RETURNING alias_n

cases.name: source_qualified_argument
cases.query: UPDATE cte_scope_alias SET alias_n = (SELECT n FROM pg_temp.host_rows(cte_scope_alias.alias_n) AS cte_scope_alias LIMIT 1) RETURNING alias_n

cases.name: source_scalar_subquery_argument
cases.query: UPDATE cte_scope_alias SET alias_n = (SELECT n FROM pg_temp.host_rows((SELECT alias_n)) LIMIT 1) RETURNING alias_n

cases.name: source_view_subquery_argument
cases.query: UPDATE cte_scope_subquery SET n = (SELECT n FROM pg_temp.host_rows(calc) LIMIT 1) RETURNING n

cases.name: peer_local_argument
cases.query: UPDATE cte_scope_view SET n = (SELECT g FROM pg_temp.host_rows(3) a CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(n,n) g LIMIT 1) RETURNING n

cases.name: peer_outer_argument
cases.query: UPDATE cte_scope_alias SET alias_n = (SELECT g FROM pg_temp.host_rows(3) a CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(alias_n,alias_n) g LIMIT 1) RETURNING alias_n

cases.name: peer_qualifier_collision
cases.query: UPDATE cte_scope_alias SET alias_n = (SELECT g FROM pg_temp.host_rows(3) cte_scope_alias CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(alias_n,alias_n) g LIMIT 1) RETURNING alias_n

cases.name: peer_renamed_local_argument
cases.query: UPDATE cte_scope_alias SET alias_n = (SELECT g FROM pg_temp.host_alias_rows(3) a CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(alias_n,alias_n) g LIMIT 1) RETURNING alias_n

cases.name: join_outer_condition
cases.query: UPDATE cte_scope_alias SET alias_n = (SELECT a.n FROM pg_temp.host_rows(3) a JOIN generate_series(1,1) g ON alias_n=10 LIMIT 1) RETURNING alias_n

cases.name: join_local_condition
cases.query: UPDATE cte_scope_alias SET alias_n = (SELECT a.alias_n FROM pg_temp.host_alias_rows(3) a JOIN generate_series(1,1) g ON alias_n=0 LIMIT 1) RETURNING alias_n

cases.name: non_lateral_outer_argument
cases.query: UPDATE cte_scope_alias SET alias_n = (SELECT result FROM pg_temp.host_alias_rows(3) a, (SELECT alias_n AS result) q LIMIT 1) RETURNING alias_n

cases.name: join_outer_scalar_subquery
cases.query: UPDATE cte_scope_alias SET alias_n = (SELECT a.n FROM pg_temp.host_rows(3) a JOIN generate_series(1,1) g ON (SELECT alias_n)=10 LIMIT 1) RETURNING alias_n

cases.name: lateral_join_outer_condition
cases.query: UPDATE cte_scope_alias SET alias_n = (SELECT a.n FROM pg_temp.host_rows(3) a JOIN LATERAL generate_series(a.n,a.n) g ON alias_n=10 LIMIT 1) RETURNING alias_n

cases.name: returning_local_qualifier
cases.query: UPDATE cte_scope_returning SET n=n RETURNING WITH (OLD AS incoming, NEW AS outgoing) (SELECT calc FROM pg_temp.host_rows(3) LIMIT 1)

cases.name: dynamic_user_overload
cases.query: SET LOCAL search_path = public, pg_catalog; UPDATE cte_scope_alias SET alias_n = (SELECT g FROM pg_temp.host_rows(3) a CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(a.n,a.n) g LIMIT 1) RETURNING alias_n

cases.name: hash_join_outer_condition
cases.query: UPDATE cte_scope_alias SET alias_n = (SELECT a.n FROM pg_temp.host_rows(3) a JOIN generate_series(0,2) g ON a.n::integer=g AND alias_n=10 ORDER BY a.n LIMIT 1) RETURNING alias_n
